_about: Poll-closing times (Eastern) for states without a 2026 Senate race, whose times aren't in the Wikipedia 2026 Senate table. Started from 270toWin's 2024 list; every state below was checked on Sept. 30, 2026 against its Secretary of State / elections office (see 'confirmed'). Only North Dakota differed from the 270toWin list in substance: its counties choose their own closing time between 7 and 9pm local, so the time shown is the usual 7pm local close.
source: 270toWin poll closing times (2024 general election list), each confirmed against the state's own election office on Sept. 30, 2026

AZ.official_hours: 6am–7pm MST. Arizona stays on standard time, so 7pm MST = 9pm Eastern.

HI.official_hours: 7am–7pm HST (all-mail state; voter service centers close 7pm HST = midnight Eastern).

IN.official_hours: 6am–6pm local time: Eastern-time counties 6pm ET, Central-time counties 6pm CT = 7pm ET.

ND.official_hours: Counties set their own hours: polls open between 7 and 9am and close between 7 and 9pm local time (most close 7pm). Central-time counties 7pm CT = 8pm ET; Mountain-time counties 7pm MT = 9pm ET. A county that stays open later closes later.

UT.official_hours: 7am–8pm MT (vote-by-mail state; ballots must arrive by 8pm MT = 10pm ET).

VT.official_hours: Each town opens between 5 and 10am; all close 7pm ET.

WA.official_hours: Drop boxes and voting centers close 8pm PT = 11pm ET; mailed ballots need an Election Day postmark.

notes.ND: Counties choose their own closing time (7–9pm local); the time shown is the usual 7pm local close, so a county can close later.
